scope: read-only review of existing reports; no RTL/source review, synthesis, training, bitstream generation, board access, or Flash write

deadline_context.assessment: The saved evidence does not support promising a complete 67-layer RoadYOLO deployment by the functional freeze. The remaining work includes the true deployment model, 64 convolutions and non-convolution graph control, full DDR DMA, FPGA decode/NMS, whole-system implementation, and board acceptance.

overall.summary: Reusable arithmetic and a three-convolution Stem/down2 front end exist with strong local simulation evidence. Separate small-core and four-address DDR diagnostics have also passed user-observed board checks. No report proves a true-model, 67-convolution, DDR-to-postprocess-to-video closed loop.

resource_and_throughput.interpretation: The component-top figures overlap and cannot be added into a whole-system estimate. The three-convolution front end alone consumes 11.883456M normal core cycles before the remaining 64 convolutions, DDR, non-convolution operators, decode/NMS, and video, so the reports do not prove 5 FPS and show a severe schedule/performance risk.

minimum_required_path.gate: Freeze one competition FP32 checkpoint and a lowered, explicit acceptance floor
minimum_required_path.deliverable: model ID/hash, fixed validation sources, confidence/NMS/output-cap policy, and go/no-go record
minimum_required_path.note: Do not keep both E7 and replay-G10 open-ended. replay-G10 is currently retained but not promoted because camera trends are inconsistent.

minimum_required_path.gate: Create the true deployment parameter package
minimum_required_path.deliverable: BN-folded weights, per-output-channel scales, INT32 bias, pre/post requant parameters, exact SiLU table, INT16 heads, tensor-scale alignment, saturation/tw-th rules, graph/model manifest, and hashes
minimum_required_path.note: A short QAT or calibration-recovery run is necessary only to recover the chosen quantized model. Distillation is optional and should not enter the critical path unless one bounded A/B run clearly beats the frozen checkpoint before this gate closes.

minimum_required_path.gate: Close the software integer golden model
minimum_required_path.deliverable: all 67 convolutions and non-convolution nodes, per-layer tensor comparisons, true decode/Top-K/NMS, and selected-video end-to-end metrics from the exact exported package
remaining 64 convolutions, pool/residual/split/concat/upsample, fixed-graph sequencer, true parameter loading, and full-tensor bit-exact regression
minimum_required_path.note: If RTL source review or modification is requested, use the readable-verilog-generator workflow; this snapshot did not inspect RTL bodies.

minimum_required_path.deliverable: extend the passed four-address board test to address carry, byte masks and planned tensor boundaries; then prove a non-repeating real CNN tensor round trip, whole-tensor DMA, ownership/commit/release, and video/CNN arbitration
minimum_required_path.note: The 64-byte test and user-reported 10-minute green display are valid board evidence, but the test stops in PASS and is not continuous DDR stress.

minimum_required_path.gate: Complete FPGA postprocess and video integration
minimum_required_path.deliverable: INT16 prediction decode, threshold, Top-K, NMS, frame-stable result table, HDMI overlay, and frame identity checks
100 MHz setup/hold and external-interface reports, complete resource report, real cycles/frame including stalls and DDR, and a release decision
minimum_required_path.note: H24 remains the only approved topology fallback, but it still needs measured accuracy and whole-path cycle evidence; it is not automatically selected by the current small-front-end result.

minimum_required_path.deliverable: whole-network bitstream, real camera/video detection, effective FPS, dropped frames, result age, 30-minute stability, accuracy under the frozen policy, and autonomous-start evidence if required
